condition_11_mechanism.how: proof/check_disposition.py confirms the disposition record exists, carries verdict PASSED, names a commit reachable from HEAD, and that the authority core is unchanged since review.
condition_11_mechanism.explicit_limit: It cannot verify that the review was competent, or that it happened. Its authority is external and the record is a receipt, not a proof. Recorded this way rather than as a boolean in gate.py so the distinction stays visible: the gate reports what an authority decided, it does not decide.

Detector rules E3D-001..006 are deterministic regex over verbatim; coverage and false-negative rate unmeasured.
Unvalidated tunables remain unfalsified. cc.probe_instances records predicted_partition vs observed_answer_class to enable it; no falsification run.
INV-CC-REVELATION-CEILING remains PROPOSED and is not mechanically enforceable.
No chamber seal law ratified. Both manifests are integrity snapshots, not doctrinal SELF seals.
Multi-node/cross-session: RLS, durable idempotency keys, identity drift unwritten.
VERIFIED is not reproducible from the repository alone; after a clone the live suites report UNAVAILABLE and the verdict falls back to HOLD. By design.
INV-ISX-REVIEW-RESOLVABILITY is adopted for this channel but not mechanically enforced — no emitter check refuses a review-transferring INSELFACTION with a null remote.
E3 is verified as an authority boundary, not as a useful detector. Nothing here shows the rules fire on real conversation at a useful rate.
